description:
J GEEK Federation
English Translation
Mod version 1.4.0 · Starsector 0.98a-RC5

The Geeks have arrived.

Click a poster to view it's full size.

>> DOWNLOAD (English) <<
Original mod on Fossic  |  GitHub repo

What is this?
An English translation of 极客联盟 (J GEEK Federation) by JJACK and team, translated with the author's permission.

Author's permission

极杰客船长 (JJACK), on Fossic: "Hi Possible, no problem. Thanks for your effort. If you need anything, feel free to ask me."

A colossal fleet stumbles out of an unknown parallel space into the Persean Sector, calling themselves the Geek Federation. They didn't come alone: the rebel miners they fled are right behind them.

Features

Two new factions: the Geek Federation and the Way of Ji, a rebel miners' union
Crystal-tech fleets, including the Four Symbols mechs (Azure Dragon, White Tiger, Vermilion Bird, Black Tortoise) with swappable weapon modules
The Celestial Gate, an experimental ship you upgrade module by module
An energy crystal economy, with new commodities, industries and faction stations up to the Star Castle
12 bounties, a bar event storyline and a story achievement
Exploration and terraforming missions, plus buildable Asteroid Defense Batteries (all configurable in LunaLib)
Optional Nexerelin start: The Lost Experiment

Requirements

LazyLib
MagicLib
GraphicsLib
LunaLib
Nexerelin (optional)

Installation

Unzip into your [tt]Starsector/mods[/tt] folder, so you end up with [tt]mods/JKF[/tt].
If you have the Chinese version installed, delete it first. Both versions share the same mod ID.
Enable J GEEK Federation in the launcher.

Save compatibility: No ship, weapon or item IDs were changed, so a save from the Chinese version should carry over. Back up your save first anyway.

Translation notes

Everything players see is translated: ships, weapons, hullmods, descriptions, bounties, events, missions, menus, tooltips and the faction posters.
The mod's code (jkf.jar) was recompiled with the translated text. No gameplay values were changed.
Where the author gave official English names (J GEEK Federation, J GEEK Rebels, Star Castle), those were kept.
A few small fixes in the original files: a broken reward ID in one exploration event, mislabeled and garbled variant names, and leftover formatting marks in some tooltips.

AI usage disclaimer
This translation was made with AI assistance (Claude). The AI drafted the translations and the poster text edits. Every file then went through review passes where I chose the final names and wording and checked them for consistency across the mod. No original art was AI-generated. If anything reads oddly, please report it and I'll fix it.

Known issues
None yet. This is a fresh release, so reports are welcome.

Credits

Original mod: JJACK (lead), Demon, Yun Pope, Xiaokang Tuantuan (art), JCan, S1mplEasy
